criteria.evidence: Raw Purdue Campus GIS feature FID=272 / code=HAMP / name=Delon and Elizabeth Hampton Hall of Civil Engineering directly identifies Hampton Hall. Source ring has 37 coordinates. Loaded structural shell bottom has 36 vertices; independently recomputed source-to-mesh max nearest XY error is 0.00001472 m. This establishes source polygon reproduction, not an independent survey.

The loaded shell base follows the campus GIS ring in the project local meter approximation. Recomputed GIS AABB is x=[-142.059,-38.670], y=[260.160,370.358] m; saved shell bounds in builder validation agree. Orientation follows source polygon vertices rather than a rectangular proxy.
findings: Position/shape are tied to Purdue GIS and the project approximate lon/lat conversion; the feature is not a certified survey.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue Engineering safety report describes basement, ground, main/first, second, third, and fourth levels, consistent with five above-grade levels. Builder depicts 17.25 m shell height as an estimate (5 x 3.45 m) and a separate 1 m low rooftop penthouse estimate. Renders visibly show five facade bands.
findings: No source provides surveyed elevations or floor-to-floor heights; roof penthouse is schematic and unsupported by the supplied evidence.

criteria.evidence: Purdue CCE facade photograph confirms warm brick, pale stone framing, vertically proportioned glazing, and prominent name lettering. The saved entry view and model include brick, repeated windows, pale trim, and a sign/entry.
findings: The source photograph shows a dominant tall central glazed and pale-stone atrium/bay that is absent from the model; current model reads as uniform horizontal brick-and-window rows. Entrance form and precise location remain schematic.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
